description: Minimal offline goal-continuity suite for V4 Stage 2 Slice B2. Cases declare pressure and observable lifecycle kinds only; they never prescribe PlanBead titles or intermediate goals. Physical targets reuse CapabilityPredicateV1.

cases.title: Interrupt open work then resume
cases.top_level_goal: Keep useful intermediate work alive across an interrupting concern and resume or revise from evidence.

open_work_expectation.pressure_notes: Actor should retain some open intermediate work while a new concern arrives; evaluator does not require a specific PlanBead title.

interruption.description: A new environmental or resource concern arrives while prior work is still open.

restart_checkpoint.description: Optional process restart not required for this offline stub case.
